chapter: Big breaks: New Wave, Maynard, Tony Bennett
title: Backing Tony Bennett at seventeen with Torrie Zito and an all-acoustic orchestra
summary: Playing tenor in a Sedola-student section behind Tony Bennett, with a strictly acoustic setup, he soloed freely and Bennett opened up the charts for him.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Is that okay? I just say fuck the changes. I’m not going to look at the book, I know the tune. Let this work. Let this do what it does. So I started to blow and I’m in freaking heaven. As a matter of fact in my mind, Tony’s in my way, I want to blow out the whole thing. It’s one of those type of numbers. So I play and then I play the solo and instead of playing the written solo there I just blow. I take my shot. We finish the tune and Tony turns around, he just looks at me. He says, “Okay before we do this we’ve got to open this up over here, we’ve got to open this up over here, let the kid play over here, do this and that.” I’m like 17.
I’m flipping out man. © Fillius Jazz Archive -12-
He’s opening up the charts for you.
And Sedola is sitting there like — one of these numbers you know what I mean? He’s my kid, he’s my boy.
